room.prompt: A beach at dawn seen from right down at the sand: huge soft grains of sand in the front, a giant fingertip coming down from the top right, the sea and the pale sky soft and far behind.

stage.where: on the sand in the front middle
stage.near: the grains of sand around it are its own size, the fingertip far bigger

tip.prompt: A close view of a giant fingertip holding a few big pale grains of sand against a quiet pale dawn sky, a calm empty band of sky across the top for a title.

stage.where: on top of the fingertip in the middle
stage.near: the other grains on the fingertip are its own size

s_closed.pose: resting with eyes closed, curled small, calm

s_open.pose: the same, eyes just opening, a slow blink

s_tilt.pose: sitting up, head tilted, curious, looking up and off to the right

s_peer.pose: leaning forward over an edge on its tummy, peering down, brows up

s_steady.pose: rising to its feet, arms out to steady itself, a little wobble

s_look.pose: standing, a hand shading its eyes, looking out into the distance with growing interest
